attr.title: Panzer Dragoon Saga
attr.desc: Panzer Dragoon Saga (Sega Saturn, 1998) running natively on ARM64: the reverse-engineered Azel engine with Saturn VDP1/VDP2 presentation translated to OpenGL ES 3. No emulation. Supply your own disc dump.
attr.inst_md: Extract your own legally dumped USA disc set with `tools/extract_disc.py` into `panzerdragoon/data/disc1`. Disc 1 is hash-verified against blythos/atolm's sha256 manifest.

status.notes: Engine: yaz0r/Azel (MIT). Disc identity manifests: blythos/atolm (MIT). Not affiliated with SEGA.
